name: Viaura
description:
Viaura – a fast, modern Android media player & hub.

• Local video & audio player (MPV engine, hardware decoding, PiP, background play, gestures)
• Subtitles: styling, external/embedded tracks, download & AI translation
• Online Music & Video search with recommendations, lyrics and playlists
• Downloads manager + torrent download support
• CloudStream (.cs3) plugin & repository support
• M3U / network streams, archive (ZIP/RAR) playback
• Private vault, favourites, folders, sleep timer, Cast
• Liquid Glass UI with themes and light/dark/AMOLED modes
